messages:
eli: quick ping — opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-inference/pull/4822. It's a cleanup/refactor that extracts a few helper functions from runtime/exec into runtime/utils and standardizes import paths. ~40 LOC, mostly renames. Can someone take a look for style + import fallout? :pray:

mari: looks small, i can glance after standup :eyes:

prashant: fyi moving files can break downstream packages. did you update BUILD files and run the unit tests? also run `go vet` if you haven't.

eli: yep updated BUILD targets and ran unit + integration tests locally. `go vet` clean. left a short note in the PR about the search/replace I ran:```\n# commands i used
git mv runtime/exec/helpers.go runtime/utils/helpers.go
rg "runtime/exec" -l | xargs sed -i 's|runtime/exec|runtime/utils|g'
```

samir: quick request — can we avoid mixing pure renames with behavioral changes in the same patch? harder to review. If possible split into rename commit + cleanup commit.

eli: done — split into two commits in the same PR: 1) rename/move only, 2) small refactor (extracted a private helper, no public API changes). noted that in the PR description.

jess: i'll take a full pass tomorrow morning. quick nit in the diff: some comment lines lost the period at end, and a couple of trailing commas style-wise. leaving inline comments now. :memo:

eli: thanks — addressed the comment punctuation and updated the commit. pushed again. CI is passing on linux/amd64, mac still queued.

opsbot: CI: linux/amd64 ✅  tests passed (42 seconds)

prashant: saw the comments — LGTM for the rename commit. the refactor commit needs one more test around the helper edge-case i left a note about.

eli: added the test and re-ran. new CI run started.

luke: glanced — this is straightforward. approved the PR and marked it for merge tomorrow during the low-traffic window. :shipit:

mari: thanks for splitting commits, much easier to review.

eli: great, thanks everyone. i'll merge tomorrow morning (UTC-8) unless anyone objects. leaving the PR open until then for any last-minute comments. :thumbsup:
